question: Which of the following is known as Caustic soda?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NaOH.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **NaOH **or **Sodium hydroxide** is a **strong base** which is also known as **caustic soda.**
 
• It is also **called Lye** due to its corrosive nature.
 
• **Uses:**
 
 
• **Cleansing agent **
 
• **Manufacturing of washing soda**
 
• **Manufacture of pulp, paper**
 
• **Extraction of aluminum**
 
• **Manufacture of petroleum products**
 
 

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Mg(OH)2 ** is **Magnesium hydroxide. **Like NaOH, it is also a strong base. 
 
• **CaSO4 **is a** salt of calcium** i.e. **calcium sulfate.**
 
• **CuSO4 **is a **salt of copper **i.e. **copper (II) sulfate**. This is otherwise known as **blue vitriol.**
